messages:
carmen: After yesterday's postmortem, quick proposal: combine IC-rotation checklist updates with a short 'remediation escrow' workflow so handoffs don't lose action items. Outline follows.

lee: Curious — what's in the escrow record?

carmen: Minimal fields: Owner, Escrow (backup), Escrow expiry, Priority, Verify-step (link or short checklist), Recurrence tag, Handoff note. Also a small timeline template attached: Detect -> Triage -> Fix -> Verify -> Close (with ETA windows per priority).

frank: ETA windows? propose: P0 = 72h, P1 = 7d, P2 = 21d. If owner misses expiry, escrow becomes owner automatically and oncall gets pinged.

tara: For comms cadence: when escrow created bot posts single-line to #eng-oncall + service channel: "Action <id> — owner — ETA — blocker". Then concise updates every 72h until closed. No verbose logs in channel.

lee: IC rotation change: add an "IC observer" in the handoff doc who reviews all open escrows >48h and marks any needing immediate attention. Add a 3-step handoff template in playbook: 1) quick summary, 2) outstanding escrows, 3) escalation points.

carmen: Also want a recurrence tagging rule: incidents get a recurrence key derived from error fingerprint and service. If same key appears 3x in 60 days, auto-create a "recurrence-review" ticket assigned to infra lead + product manager.

frank: Verification: require a proof-of-fix link when closing (dashboard snapshot or smoke test link). No proof => bot reopens escrow. Keeps things honest.

ops-bot: [reminder] Escrow 2245001111-2 due in 24h — pinging escrow owner @lee.

tara: For transparency, weekly digest to SRE leads with open escrows and recurrence candidates. Include simple KPIs: median time-to-close, % with verification, recurrence count.

lee: I'll add the IC observer spot to the rotation spreadsheet and update the oncall playbook.

carmen: I'll create a pilot board for infra services only, include the timeline template and sample escrow cards. Plan: 3-week pilot, then retro. Next: demo 15m on Tue.

frank: I'll prototype the recurrence keyer in alerts repo and wire the 3x/60d rule.

carmen: Action items: (1) carmen sets up pilot board + README by Fri, (2) lee updates playbook and adds handoff template by Mon, (3) frank wires recurrence rule + test by Mon, (4) tara configures bot posts and weekly digest by Tue. Demo Tue 15m. Post one-line updates in this thread during pilot.

lee: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/oncall-playbook/pull/99 — adds IC-observer and handoff template.

frank: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pull/210 — adds recurrence-keyer test.

carmen: Thanks team — hope to reduce forgotten actions and catch recurring failures earlier. :eyes:
